newsitem.title: USA: Innovo sees Q2 loss after property sale.
newsitem.headline: Innovo sees Q2 loss after property sale.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc on Tuesday said it expected to record a non-cash loss of about $300,000 in the second quarter when it closes the sale of a Florida property it was developing as a retail outlet.
The company said it signed an agreement for the April 30 sale of the property.
Under the pact, Innovo said, it would receive an aggregate of $1.8 million, comprised of $400,000 cash and debt assumption and second lien notes of $1.4 million.
The company's cash proceeds will allow it to finance second-quarter product development costs, and certain debt payments.
